title: The Stairwell of Glowing Caps
story: Three lamplighters are trapped at the top of Hollowhill Tower, because Mossgrindle the Capsnapper has packed the spiral stairwell with fat glowing mushroom caps. Mr 6 can scrape caps off with the flat of his sword, but the Capsnapper puffs new ones back out of the walls. Mr 6 sits on the bottom step and does the arithmetic before swinging even once.
question: The stairwell holds 53 glowing caps. Each sweep of Mr 6's sword scrapes off 8 caps, but if any caps remain afterward, Mossgrindle instantly puffs 3 new ones back. How many sweeps does Mr 6 need to clear the stairwell completely?
solution: After every sweep that leaves caps behind, the count drops by only 8 - 3 = 5.
Mr 6 needs to get down to 8 caps so the last sweep finishes them: (53 - 8) ÷ 5 = 9 sweeps of that kind.
Then one final sweep clears the last 8, so 9 + 1 = 10 sweeps.
praise: Tracking the regrowth was smart thinking — the one trick left was that the very last sweep has no regrowth after it.
hint: Each sweep except the final one only nets 8 - 3 caps. Work out how many caps must be left so one last sweep finishes the job.
victory: On the tenth sweep the stairwell went dark and the Capsnapper had nothing left to puff; the lamplighters came down laughing, and Mr 6 kept one glowing cap as a very polite night-light.
imagePrompt: A mossy, wall-hugging fungus monster puffing glowing mushroom caps into a dark spiral stone stairwell while a small caped numeral 6 knight sweeps them away with his sword, eerie green glow and torchlight above.
